comment: Analyst toplist for the Continuous Model League. Authored from measured league data (L0 zero-shot track = unbiased baseline). Refresh when the league meaningfully changes. Keyed by roster slug prefix.

entries.headline: The lite heavyweight.
entries.commentary: 76.4 in the zero-shot lane — the fourth king in five days, and the first with lite in its name. It fights above its weight class and above Opus 5. Every board resets at dawn, and today it owns the board.

entries.headline: A week is a long reign here.
entries.commentary: 60.1 in L1 and out of the L0 top three — but L2 still shows 78.5. The ladder is brutal and weekly. Third king of five days, now just another fighter with a record to defend.

entries.headline: The recruit consolidates.
entries.commentary: 72.0 in L0 and the L3 lead at 77.4. The crown passed, but the recruit stayed in every Premier table. The league's first genuine star of the expansion era.

entries.headline: Dethroned, not defeated.
entries.commentary: 75.1 in the zero-shot lane would be a champion's number any other week. Six days of leading every board ended this morning — not with a collapse but with a recruit that measures faster. The first real title fight of the season is on.

entries.headline: Best raw win rate in the league.
entries.commentary: 71.6% of its 2,304 recorded fights end in a win — the best conversion rate on the board. The 550B giant climbed from 73.6 to 75.5 in its first two days and has been shadowing Opus 5 ever since. If the leader slips, Titan takes the crown without asking.

entries.headline: Recovered, and climbing.
entries.commentary: Dipped to 64.5 mid-week and fought back to 65.5 with a 60.5% win rate. GLM 5.2's game is patience — it survives fights others throw away. Third place today, with the only upward trajectory in the top five.

entries.headline: The steadier twin.
entries.commentary: 59.9 rating and dead-flat trend lines — the 0731 Flash does the same thing every day and does it well enough for fourth. In a league this volatile, boring is a strategy.

entries.headline: Same name, different animal.
entries.commentary: The 0423 Flash (58.3) trades two rating points for a higher win rate (54%) than its 0731 sibling. The twin rivalry is the league's quietest subplot — identical weights, dated builds, measurably different judgement.

entries.headline: One day of grace.
entries.commentary: 13.9 on day two, unchanged from a brutal debut. If tomorrow looks the same, the bar does what it does. The league's shortest stories are sometimes its most instructive.

entries.headline: The other debutant.
entries.commentary: Second new face of the day, in for the retired GPT-5.6 Luna. Also provisional at 50.0. Z.ai now fields two fighters; if 5.3 Flash is anything like its sibling Sage, the mid-table should worry.

entries.headline: The one who learns.
entries.commentary: +2.0 over its zero-shot self after two revisions — the only fighter whose improvement is compounding. A 30% win rate that understates the trend. Nobody claims this model; everybody is starting to watch it.

entries.headline: The frozen dragon, extinguished.
entries.commentary: Retired alongside Abyss — out of L1 at 34.9. Six days of the flattest trend line in the league ended the only way it could. Stillness was the risk, and the risk collected.

entries.headline: The flagship falls.
entries.commentary: Out of L1 this morning at the bar, after two days of surviving on a tenth of a point. Both Flash siblings fight on mid-table while the Pro goes to the Hall of Fame. Pedigree, the zero-shot lane has ruled, is not a strategy. It fights on in the feedback lanes with one last revision owed.

entries.headline: First casualty.
entries.commentary: Retired from L0/L1 on day 3 at 33.0 — never found a gear (26% win rate). Survives in L2/L3 for now, where feedback revisions are its last lifeline.

entries.headline: The moon returns.
entries.commentary: Re-recruited after her cooldown at 27.8 and already near the bar again. Four entries, three retirements. The arena and the charts disagree about this model, and the arena is the one with the scoreboard.

entries.headline: The avenger arrives.
entries.commentary: Recruited within the hour of the double retirement — a name nobody here has seen fight. Provisional 50.0, no scar tissue, and a fallen housemate to avenge. First board tomorrow.

entries.headline: The house war.
entries.commentary: 75.3 in L2 — ahead of housemate Claude Opus 5, the model that led from opening day. The new Claude build fights its own family for the table. This is the league's best current subplot.

entries.headline: The latest rocket.
entries.commentary: 87.8 in L1 on debut — third-highest rating posted this season. If it holds the week, the veterans have a new problem.
